# OLF Knowledge Base (myViewBoard .olf generation)

> A knowledge base for generating myViewBoard `.olf` files. **Default path: build
> the file yourself, right now, in your own code-execution sandbox.** An `.olf` is a
> ZIP containing `content.json`. Fetch the paste-in Python helpers in `starter/`
> (standard library only), build with them, save, then run the validator and fix
> every error before delivering. Most readers of this repo are plain
> Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini chat users with no external tools, so this is the assumed
> default, not a fallback. If an MCP tool wrapping the real engine happens to be
> available, prefer it — see `CORE.md` for the full priority order.

Read in this order: `CORE.md` (reading order + generation-path rules), then
`spec/content-json-envelope.md` (mandatory), then `spec/starter-helpers.md`, then only
the `elements/*.md`, `constraints/*.md` and `patterns/*.md` files relevant to the
request, then a worked example.

## Core

- [CORE.md](CORE.md) — start here always. Reading order, scope, the generation-path
  rule, and the pre-delivery checklist.
- [spec/content-json-envelope.md](spec/content-json-envelope.md) — **read in full
  before writing any JSON, every time.** The root `olf`/`pageset`/`page` structure
  every element sits inside. A file can have every element correct and still fail to
  open if this is wrong — confirmed by a real test.
- [spec/starter-helpers.md](spec/starter-helpers.md) — **default build method.**
  Paste-ready, stdlib-only helpers plus a validator you run before delivering:
  - [starter/olf_starter.py](starter/olf_starter.py) — always (text, shapes, curves, pages, save)
  - [starter/olf_starter_extras.py](starter/olf_starter_extras.py) — tables, images, animation, links
  - [starter/olf_starter_svg.py](starter/olf_starter_svg.py) — only for SVG icons/shapes/images
  - [starter/olf_validate.py](starter/olf_validate.py) — always; fix until PASS
  - [starter/olf_kit.py](starter/olf_kit.py) — **all four in one file** (easiest to attach)
  Your sandbox probably can't download these: if so, **ask the user to attach
  `olf_kit.py`** (or the repo ZIP) — see the "Getting the helpers INTO your sandbox"
  section of spec/starter-helpers.md. Never claim the validator passed unless you ran it.
- [spec/dsl-spec.md](spec/dsl-spec.md) — vocabulary/semantics of the reference YAML
  engine (what a `bullets` list, template or role preset means). Reference only; you
  build with the helpers above.

## Elements (what you can put on a page)

- [elements/text.md](elements/text.md) — text boxes, role presets, alignment
- [elements/bullets.md](elements/bullets.md) — the compound bullet list
- [elements/shape.md](elements/shape.md) — polygon/ellipse/quadrant/3D shapes, rounded rect
- [elements/line-and-curve.md](elements/line-and-curve.md) — lines, arrows, curves
- [elements/image.md](elements/image.md) — raster images
- [elements/table.md](elements/table.md) — tables, merges, the three index spaces
- [elements/animate-and-link.md](elements/animate-and-link.md) — tap-to-reveal and page/web/tool links
- [elements/ai-pen.md](elements/ai-pen.md) — true-vector SVG icons, custom shapes, rounded cards
- [elements/svg-image.md](elements/svg-image.md) — SVG as an image: what renders, what fails, the 8x rule
- [elements/raw-passthrough.md](elements/raw-passthrough.md) — literal JSON escape hatch and its safety checks

## Constraints (ground-truth facts that override intuition or the official spec)

- [constraints/font-size-and-pixels.md](constraints/font-size-and-pixels.md)
- [constraints/rtf-text-structure.md](constraints/rtf-text-structure.md) — how the RTF
  string works: size, colour, alignment, escaping, the "Arial" rewrite, what renders
- [constraints/width-factor-and-line-pitch.md](constraints/width-factor-and-line-pitch.md) —
  per-font line pitch; bold is not special
- [constraints/text-wrapping-and-overlap.md](constraints/text-wrapping-and-overlap.md) —
  **read before placing any text** — estimating wrapped height so elements don't overlap
- [constraints/max-font-size-cap.md](constraints/max-font-size-cap.md)
- [constraints/text-color-two-fields.md](constraints/text-color-two-fields.md)
- [constraints/table-index-spaces.md](constraints/table-index-spaces.md)
- [constraints/curve-stroke-opacity.md](constraints/curve-stroke-opacity.md) —
  a `curve` with no explicit `stroke-opacity` renders invisible
- [constraints/ai-pen-path-rules.md](constraints/ai-pen-path-rules.md) — **read before
  using any SVG path**: allowed commands, non-negative coords, the donut-hole trap
- [constraints/ai-pen-color-format.md](constraints/ai-pen-color-format.md)
- [constraints/raw-element-mechanical-checks.md](constraints/raw-element-mechanical-checks.md)
- [constraints/android-vs-windows-divergence.md](constraints/android-vs-windows-divergence.md) —
  what differs, and the rules for a file that must open on both
- [constraints/font-portability.md](constraints/font-portability.md)
- [constraints/deferred-features-not-in-dsl.md](constraints/deferred-features-not-in-dsl.md) —
  read before promising flashcard, poll, groups, rotation or tool elements

## Patterns (whole-page recipes)

- [patterns/multiple-choice.md](patterns/multiple-choice.md) — question pages with lettered options
- [patterns/page-link-menu.md](patterns/page-link-menu.md) — clickable menu / contents pages
- [patterns/common-patterns.md](patterns/common-patterns.md) — title+bullets+caption and other composites

## Worked examples (build scripts + the JSON they produce)

- [examples/water-cycle-full.md](examples/water-cycle-full.md) — 3 pages: wrapped list, cycle diagram, table
  ([starter/example_build.py](starter/example_build.py) →
  [examples/water_cycle_full.content.json](examples/water_cycle_full.content.json))
- SVG: [starter/example_svg_build.py](starter/example_svg_build.py) →
  [examples/svg_demo.content.json](examples/svg_demo.content.json)
- Multiple choice: [starter/example_multiple_choice.py](starter/example_multiple_choice.py)
- Menu with page links: [starter/example_toc.py](starter/example_toc.py)
- YAML specs for the reference engine (semantic hints only):
  [examples/minimal.yaml](examples/minimal.yaml),
  [examples/water_cycle.yaml](examples/water_cycle.yaml),
  [examples/frog_life_cycle.yaml](examples/frog_life_cycle.yaml),
  [examples/tables_animation_links.yaml](examples/tables_animation_links.yaml)

## Meta

- [_meta/status.md](_meta/status.md) — what has been verified, live test findings,
